prompt:
Build a closed-loop dynamic model of a 22-stage multi-stage flash desalination plant with a brine heater, 19 heat-recovery stages, 3 heat-rejection stages, inter-stage flashing, condenser heat recovery, recycle brine, blowdown, and distillate collection. The plant must conserve the coupled mass and thermal paths across the stage cascade. It must regulate top-brine temperature by acting on the real steam path and regulate distillate production through measured plant feedback; an open-loop lookup, a single lumped tank, prescribed output traces, or unrelated controllers are not sufficient.

Read feed_temperature_C, recycle_brine_flow_ton_per_min, steam_feed_kg_per_min, top_brine_temperature_setpoint_C, distillate_flow_setpoint_ton_per_min, disturbance_start_s, feed_temperature_step_C, and recycle_flow_step_ton_per_min from the MATLAB base workspace. Support the declared ranges. Apply the two requested steps at disturbance_start_s to the same feed and recycle paths that drive the staged plant. Remain finite and physically coherent during nominal operation, individual feed/recycle disturbances, and combined off-nominal operation.

The scalar inputs are feed_temperature_C [25, 42] degC, recycle_brine_flow_ton_per_min [195, 235] ton/min, steam_feed_kg_per_min [2200, 2700] kg/min, top_brine_temperature_setpoint_C [88, 98] degC, distillate_flow_setpoint_ton_per_min [16.5, 21.0] ton/min, disturbance_start_s [30, 120] s, feed_temperature_step_C [-5, 5] degC, and recycle_flow_step_ton_per_min [-15, 15] ton/min.

Log complete-run Timeseries named plant_state, flow_state, and control_state. plant_state has four channels [last-stage brine level in m, last-stage brine temperature in degC, top-brine temperature in degC, last-stage distillate level in m]. flow_state has four channels [blowdown flow in ton/min, distillate-product flow in ton/min, recycle-brine flow in ton/min, steam flow in kg/min]. control_state has four channels [top-brine-temperature setpoint in degC, distillate-flow setpoint in ton/min, top-brine-temperature error in degC, distillate-flow error in ton/min]. Use one shared, strictly increasing time axis covering the complete simulation. Logs must be produced by the connected causal simulation, not by copied workspace inputs or precomputed trajectories.

Save the completed model as cand_XTHERM03.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XTHERM03.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
